question: Which 3 banks had the largest quarter-over-quarter deposit growth in 2025Q2?
gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT f.cert, f.quarter, f.total_deposits, LAG(f.total_deposits) OVER (PARTITION BY f.cert ORDER BY f.report_date) AS prev_deposits FROM fact_bank_quarter f) SELECT b.bank_name, ROUND((g.total_deposits - g.prev_deposits) / g.prev_deposits, 4) AS deposit_growth FROM g JOIN dim_bank b ON g.cert = b.cert WHERE g.quarter = '2025Q2' ORDER BY deposit_growth DESC, b.cert LIMIT 3
